title: Branding
log: 2026-11-01T08:04:32Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: Neither bank point teaches the new Branding point: global branding is narrower, covering one brand identity across countries, and product decisions is broader, treating branding as only one part of product choices.

draft.title: Branding
card: A brand is the name, logo and image that set a business and its products apart from others. Customers use it to tell businesses apart.
things the business controls that shape its brand, such as its values, its staff and the quality of its products.
things beyond the business that shape its brand, such as competitors, customer opinions and social trends.
A strong brand builds recognition, so customers know the business at a glance. It can also build loyalty, so customers keep coming back.
draft.remember: A brand sets a business apart. It is shaped from inside and outside, and can build recognition and loyalty.

a.q: Which of these is an inside factor that shapes a business's brand?
opts: The values its owners set for the business
A rival opening a shop across the road
A fall in local spending on eating out
a.why: Owners decide a business's values, so the business controls this factor. The other options come from competitors, customers or the economy, which the business does not control.
a.clue: Which one does the business itself decide?

b.q: Sam's Surf Shop in Torquay uses the same blue wave logo on its signs, bags and website. Which result is this most likely to help build?
opts: Recognition, as customers spot the shop easily
Market size, as the whole town becomes customers
Competition, as rivals copy the logo
A product extension for older surfboards
b.why: A logo used the same way everywhere helps customers know the shop at a glance, which is recognition. It does not change how many people live in the town, so market size is wrong.
b.clue: What does a repeated logo help customers do?

a.best: The values its owners set for the business

b.best: Recognition, as customers spot the shop easily
